scripts.build: bun run build:runtime && bun run build:example
scripts.build:runtime: bunx --bun dsh-react-surface-build packages/runtime && bunx tsc -p packages/runtime/tsconfig.build.json
scripts.build:example: bun run build:example:basic && bun run build:example:ag-ui
scripts.build:example:ag-ui: bunx --bun dsh-react-surface-build examples/ag-ui-tools && bunx tsc -p examples/ag-ui-tools/tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build && bun run verify:artifacts && bun run format:check
